logline: 바닷가 여관에서 자란 소년이 늙은 뱃사람의 궤짝을 열면서, 배 한 척을 가득 채운 사람들과 바다로 나선다.
destination: 섬의 표시된 자리 — 모두가 파 내려가는 구덩이
setting: 18세기 잉글랜드 바닷가 여관과 범선, 남쪽 바다의 섬
anchor: a small boy in a rough wool coat and buckled shoes with tousled hair, 18th century seaside inn and tall ship
palette: sea teal, weathered oak brown, lantern amber, pale tropical sand

beats.beat: 바닷가 여관에 늙은 뱃사람이 궤짝을 부린다.
beats.visual: a scarred old sailor dropping a heavy sea chest on the floor of a low beam inn, boy watching
beats.motion: the chest thuds down, dust jumps from the boards, the boy steps back

beats.beat: 소년이 그 궤짝에서 접힌 가죽을 꺼낸다.
beats.visual: a boy lifting a folded leather square from an open sea chest of coins and pistols, lamp beside
beats.motion: the leather unfolds in his hands, coins slide, lamplight swings

beats.beat: 눈먼 사내가 지팡이를 짚고 마을에 나타난다.
beats.visual: a blind man in a ragged cloak tapping a stick along a foggy village lane toward an inn
beats.motion: the stick taps and drags, fog rolls past him, shutters close ahead

beats.visual: a tall ship under filling canvas leaving a stone harbour, crew swarming the rigging
beats.motion: sails fill and snap taut, ropes run through blocks, the hull heels over

beats.beat: 소년이 사과통 속에서 선원들 말을 엿듣는다.
beats.visual: a boy crouched inside a wooden apple barrel on deck, sailors' legs visible through the gap
beats.motion: the barrel rocks with the swell, boots pass close, apples shift under him

beats.beat: 소년이 사과통 안에서 선원들 말을 엿듣는다.
beats.visual: a boy crouched inside a wooden apple barrel on deck, sailors' boots passing through the gap
beats.motion: the barrel rocks with the swell, boots pass close, apples shift under him

beats.visual: an open sandy pit with a broken plank at the bottom, sailors' faces ringed above it
beats.motion: sand slides down the pit wall, faces lean in together, shadows drop inside

beats.beat: 모래 위에 빈 궤짝 하나가 열려 있다.
beats.visual: an empty wooden chest lying open on pale sand, palm shadows falling across it, sea beyond
beats.motion: palm shadows sway over the chest, sand trickles from its rim, surf rolls in

withheld: 구덩이가 이미 비어 있다는 것과 요리사의 도주
